_readme: Waivers for eng/check-docs.py, which reads this file from its own directory.
A section that genuinely does not apply should be ABSENT, not filled with a
placeholder - that is the first rule in the README template. This file is how you
tell the checker so. Every waiver needs a reason: a waiver without one cannot be
told apart from giving up.
files   paths relative to the repository root. A bare name such as README.md also
matches any path ending in it; a folder with a trailing slash, such as
docs/, matches everything under it.
checks  the check codes to waive for those files.
reason  why. Required.
Check codes: LINK ESCAPES ABSPATH MERMAID ALT-TEXT EMOJI-HEADING HAND-TOC
NEW-HEADING H1 BADGES NAVBAR INSTALL-ORDER LICENCE-LAST ABOUT STATUS

STATE OF THIS REPOSITORY, 2026-09-12: README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and SECURITY.md
pass every check. The waivers below cover the working notes and plans in docs/ and
the scanned manuals in spec/, all written before the standard existed. They are
DEFERRED, not approved - each entry says so.
2026-09-29: the root-level guides, plans and handoffs that used to be waived here
(QUICK-START, USER-MANUAL, FEATURE-STATUS, the design-system documents and the rest)
were retired, so their waivers are gone with them. A waiver for a file that does
not exist is a check nobody can see is switched off.
ABSPATH IS DELIBERATELY NOT WAIVED ANYWHERE. 179 absolute paths remain in tracked
files - drive letters and, in four files, a user profile directory - and this
repository is about to become public. Those are to be fixed, not waived.
